GRID SECTIONS                           
─────────────                           
                                        
────────────────────────────────────────
Two-track grid                          
                                        
First cell sits in the left track and   
wraps within its narrower column at     
every width.                            
                                        
Second cell sits in the right track of  
the same row.                           
                                        
This spanning cell consumes both tracks 
and fills the whole row on its own line.
                                        
Ordered first via CSS order:-1, so it   
leads the grid.                         
────────────────────────────────────────
                                        
────────────────────────────────────────
Legacy stack                            
                                        
A section with no layout attr stacks its
children exactly as before.             
                                        
This is the byte-identical parity       
tripwire.                               
────────────────────────────────────────
